Provider: Università della Svizzera italiana

With the aim of further promoting the plurilingual and multicultural composition of the student body — which, in line with USI’s objectives, has proven to be of great importance also for Italian-speaking students themselves — the Università della Svizzera italiana (USI) offers scholarships to students from the German- and French-speaking cantons of Switzerland.

This scholarship is awarded automatically to all newly enrolled Bachelor 1 students and corresponds to the annual tuition fee of CHF 4,000.
